en.context: A software developer wants to install an open-source package. A visually attractive website offers a downloadable package, but its public repository has zero stars, no release history, and no verified maintainer signature.
en.question: What is the most secure and effective way to verify the package before installing it?

options.A: Install the package immediately because the landing page has professional design.
options.B: Verify its version history on official registries (npm/PyPI), source code repository, license, and community audits.
options.C: Deploy the package directly to a production server to see if it works.
options.D: Assume it is safe because it appeared as a top sponsored search result.

en.explanation: When installing open-source libraries, visual aesthetics cannot guarantee safety. Developers must audit package registry metrics, maintainer signatures, and source repositories.

uz.context: Dasturchi yangi loyihaga ochiq kodli kutubxona qo‘shmoqchi. Qidiruvda dizayni chiroyli ko‘ringan, ammo GitHub yulduzchalari va yuklab olishlar soni nolga teng bo‘lgan shubhali paket chiqdi.
uz.question: Ushbu paketni loyihaga o‘rnatishdan oldin uning ishonchliligini tekshirishning eng xavfsiz va to‘g‘ri usuli qaysi?

options.A: Sayt dizayni zamonaviy bo‘lgani uchun paketni darhol o‘rnatish.
options.B: Paketning rasmiy reestr (npm/PyPI)dagi versiyalar tarixi, ochiq manba kodi, litsenziyasi va hamjamiyat sharhlarini tekshirish.
options.C: Paketni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri production serverga yuklab sinab ko‘rish.
options.D: Qidiruv tizimida birinchi bo‘lib chiqqani uchun uni xavfsiz deb qabul qilish.

uz.explanation: Ochiq kodli dasturiy paketlarni o‘rnatishda sayt dizayniga emas, rasmiy reestrlar (npm, PyPI), manba kodi ochiqligi, yuklab olishlar soni va xavfsizlik auditiga tayanish zarur.
uz.context: A student finds a professional-looking website claiming that a specific exotic fruit will double a person’s memory overnight. No scientific studies are cited.
uz.question: What is the best way to check this claim before believing or sharing it?

options.A: Trust the information because the website has high-quality graphics and a logo.
options.B: Check whether the same claim is reported by independent, established scientific or news sources.
options.C: Share the link immediately so others can benefit.
options.D: Assume it is true because it is the first result in a search engine.

uz.explanation: Visual quality and search ranking are not evidence of truth; corroboration from independent reliable sources is stronger evidence.

uz.context: O‘quvchi professional ko‘rinadigan saytda “ma’lum bir ekzotik meva xotirani bir kechada ikki baravar kuchaytiradi” degan da’voni ko‘radi. Saytda hech qanday ilmiy tadqiqot keltirilmagan.
uz.question: Bu da’voga ishonish yoki uni ulashishdan oldin tekshirishning eng yaxshi yo‘li qaysi?

options.A: Sayt dizayni sifatli va logotipi borligi uchun ma’lumotga ishonish.
options.B: Xuddi shu da’vo mustaqil va ishonchli ilmiy yoki yangilik manbalarida ham tasdiqlanganini tekshirish.
options.C: Boshqalar ham foydalansin deb havolani darhol ulashish.
options.D: Qidiruv tizimida birinchi chiqqani uchun ma’lumotni rost deb qabul qilish.

uz.explanation: Saytning chiroyli ko‘rinishi yoki qidiruvdagi o‘rni uning to‘g‘riligini isbotlamaydi. Mustaqil va ishonchli manbalarda tasdiq bor-yo‘qligini tekshirish kuchliroq dalildir.

items.possibleFailurePattern: Deletion myth / local deletion = global deletion

en.context: A developer accidentally committed an API secret key to a public Git repository, then quickly removed the commit locally and force-pushed an update.
en.question: Why must the secret key still be considered compromised and immediately revoked?

options.A: When a Git commit is replaced, all cached copies on external servers are automatically erased.
options.B: Automated scraping bots, mirrors, forks, or local clones may have already captured the exposed secret from commit history.
options.C: API keys only become visible to third-party observers after 30 days.
options.D: Only the original repository owner has network permission to read commit diffs.

en.explanation: Public git repos are monitored by automated secret scanners. Deleting a commit does not eliminate exposure; credentials must be revoked immediately.

uz.context: Dasturchi ommaviy (public) Git repozitoriysiga adashib API maxfiy kalitini (API secret key) commit qilib yubordi. Keyin u darhol lokal kompyuterida so‘nggi commitni o‘chirib, repozitoriyni yangiladi.
uz.question: Nega maxfiy kalit ochiqlanib qolgan (komprometatsiya bo‘lgan) hisoblanadi va darhol bekor qilinishi (revoke) kerak?

options.A: Git commit o‘chirilgach, uning nusxasi butun dunyo bo‘yicha avtomatik o‘chib ketadi.
options.B: O‘chirilgunga qadar botlar, klonlar yoki keshlovchi servislar commit tarixidan kalitni nusxalab olgan bo‘lishi mumkin.
options.C: API kalitlari faqat 30 kundan keyin boshqalar uchun ko‘rinadigan bo‘ladi.
options.D: Faqat repozitoriy egasigina commit tarixini ko‘rish huquqiga ega.

uz.explanation: Public Git repozitoriylariga tushgan har qanday maxfiy ma’lumot avtomatlashtirilgan botlar tomonidan soniyalar ichida skanerlanadi. Tarixni o‘chirish xavfni bartaraf etmaydi, kalitni darhol bekor qilish kerak.

en.context: Anar sends a photo to a group chat, then chooses “Delete for everyone.”
en.question: Why could someone still have a copy of the photo?

options.A: Deleting the chat message removes every copy everywhere.
options.B: A deleted photo can never be opened again.
options.C: Someone may already have downloaded it or taken a screenshot.
options.D: Photos always disappear from every device after 24 hours.

en.explanation: Digital information can persist through copies, screenshots, caches, logs, or service-provider storage even after a deletion action.

uz.context: Anar guruh chatiga surat yuboradi, keyin “Hamma uchun o‘chirish”ni tanlaydi.
uz.question: Nega suratning nusxasi baribir kimdadir qolgan bo‘lishi mumkin?

options.A: Chatdagi xabar o‘chirilsa, barcha nusxalar ham yo‘qoladi.
options.B: O‘chirilgan suratni boshqa hech qachon ochib bo‘lmaydi.
options.C: Kimdir uni oldin yuklab olgan yoki skrinshot qilgan bo‘lishi mumkin.
options.D: Suratlar 24 soatdan keyin barcha qurilmalardan o‘z-o‘zidan yo‘qoladi.

uz.explanation: Raqamli ma’lumot nusxalar, skrinshotlar, kesh, loglar yoki xizmat provayderi saqlovi orqali o‘chirishdan keyin ham mavjud bo‘lib qolishi mumkin.

en.context: A developer needs official reference documentation for Python asynchronous sockets, but generic search queries return outdated forum discussions.

options.A: All good articles about Python socket programming
options.B: site:docs.python.org "asyncio" socket
options.C: async socket forum help questions
options.D: Reinstalling the browser and retyping the general keyword

en.explanation: Using domain filters (site:) and exact match quotes restricts results directly to official documentation roots.

options.A: Python socket dasturlash bo‘yicha barcha yaxshi maqolalar

uz.explanation: site: operatori va qo‘shtirnoq ichidagi kalit so‘zlar qidiruvni aniq domen va aniq atama bilan cheklab, rasmiy hujjatlarni topishni tezlashtiradi.
uz.context: You are researching “Mars” for a science project about space. Your search results are mostly about Mars-brand chocolate bars, which you do not need.
uz.question: Which search strategy is the most effective way to improve your results?

options.A: Type the exact same search again.
options.B: Add “planet” or “astronomy” to the query.
options.C: Only open the first result because it must be the most relevant.
options.D: Delete browsing history and restart the computer.

uz.explanation: Adding context-specific keywords narrows an ambiguous query without relying on search-engine-specific syntax.

uz.context: Siz kosmos haqidagi loyiha uchun “Mars” mavzusida qidiruv qilyapsiz. Natijalarning ko‘pi Mars nomli shokolad mahsulotlari haqida chiqmoqda.
uz.question: Qidiruv natijalarini yaxshilashning eng samarali usuli qaysi?

options.A: Xuddi shu so‘rovni yana qayta kiritish.
options.B: So‘rovga “sayyora” yoki “astronomiya” so‘zlarini qo‘shish.
options.C: Faqat birinchi natijani ochish, chunki u albatta eng mos bo‘ladi.
options.D: Brauzer tarixini o‘chirib, kompyuterni qayta ishga tushirish.

uz.explanation: Kontekstni aniqlashtiruvchi kalit so‘zlar noaniq so‘rovni toraytiradi va kerakli natijalarni topishni osonlashtiradi.

uz.subCompetency: File naming conventions in collaborative environments

en.context: A software development team needs a standard, unambiguous convention to version and track production releases.
en.question: Which release versioning convention follows the widely accepted Semantic Versioning (SemVer) standard?

options.A: app_new, app_new2, app_final_latest
options.B: app_v1, app_v2_fixed, app_v3_real
options.D: release_monday, release_tuesday, release_today

en.explanation: Semantic Versioning (SemVer: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) is the industry standard for communicating breaking changes, features, and patches.

uz.context: Jamoaviy dasturiy ta’minot ishlab chiqishda relizlar va kutubxonalar versiyalarini boshqarish talab etiladi.
uz.question: Dasturiy ta’minotda qaysi versiyalash standarti (Semantic Versioning) eng samarali va xalqaro qabul qilingan?

options.A: app_new, app_new2, app_final_oxirgi
options.B: app_v1, app_v2_tuzatilgan, app_v3_haqiqiy
options.D: release_dushanba, release_seshanba, release_bugun

uz.explanation: Semantic Versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) xalqaro standart bo‘lib, dasturning mosligi, yangi funksiyalari va tuzatishlarini aniq bildiradi.
uz.context: You are working on a group presentation called “Ecology_Project.” Your teacher wants the final folder to contain files whose version order is obvious without opening them.
uz.question: Which naming convention is the most effective?

options.A: Ecology_Project_New, Ecology_Project_New2, Ecology_Project_Newest
options.B: Ecology_Project_Final, Ecology_Project_Final_v2, Ecology_Project_Final_v3
options.C: Ecology_Project_v01, Ecology_Project_v02, Ecology_Project_v03
options.D: Project1, My_Work, Presentation_Update

uz.explanation: Sequential version numbers give an objective and unambiguous order and avoid labels such as “New” or “Final” becoming confusing.

uz.context: Siz “Ecology_Project” nomli guruh taqdimoti ustida ishlayapsiz. O‘qituvchi papkadagi fayllarning qaysi biri yangi ekanini ularni ochmasdan ham bilish mumkin bo‘lishini xohlaydi.
uz.question: Qaysi nomlash usuli eng samarali?

options.A: Ecology_Project_New, Ecology_Project_New2, Ecology_Project_Newest
options.B: Ecology_Project_Final, Ecology_Project_Final_v2, Ecology_Project_Final_v3
options.C: Ecology_Project_v01, Ecology_Project_v02, Ecology_Project_v03
options.D: Project1, My_Work, Presentation_Update

uz.explanation: Ketma-ket versiya raqamlari fayllarning tartibini aniq ko‘rsatadi va “New” yoki “Final” kabi tezda noaniq bo‘lib qoladigan nomlardan qochishga yordam beradi.

en.context: A developer building a commercial paid software product finds a utility library published under a Creative Commons BY-NC (Non-Commercial) license.
en.question: According to this license, how can the developer legally use this code?

options.A: Because the code is public, it can be bundled and sold inside a commercial product.
options.B: It may be used with attribution only for non-commercial purposes; commercial monetization is prohibited.
options.C: Removing the license header allows unrestricted proprietary monetization.
options.D: CC BY-NC strictly forbids executing the software on any computer.

en.explanation: BY-NC licenses grant free use with attribution strictly for non-commercial purposes, barring commercial integration.

uz.context: Dasturchi tijoriy (pullik) dastur tuzmoqda va GitHub dan CC BY-NC (Non-Commercial) litsenziyasidagi kod modulini topdi.
uz.question: Ushbu litsenziya qoidasiga ko‘ra moduldan qanday foydalanish mumkin?

options.A: Kod ochiq bo‘lgani uchun uni pullik dastur ichiga qo‘shib sotish mumkin.
options.B: Muallifni ko‘rsatgan holda faqat notijoriy/ta’lim maqsadlarida foydalanish mumkin; uni tijoriy mahsulotda sotish taqiqlanadi.
options.C: Litsenziyani o‘chirib tashlab, kodni o‘z muallifligi ostida xohlagancha ishlatish mumkin.
options.D: CC BY-NC litsenziyasi kodni hech qachon ishga tushirishga ruxsat bermaydi.

uz.explanation: CC BY-NC mualliflikni ko‘rsatishni (BY) va faqat notijoriy (NC) foydalanishni talab qiladi; tijoriy loyihalarda foydalanish qonunan taqiqlanadi.
uz.context: You find a photo online for a school charity fundraiser. The photo has a CC BY-NC license.
uz.question: What does this license allow?

options.A: Use it for free as long as you do not sell the photo itself.
options.B: Use it if you credit the creator and do not use it for commercial purposes.
options.C: Use it however you want because Creative Commons means public domain.
options.D: Modify it and sell it as your own work.

uz.explanation: BY requires attribution and NC restricts commercial use.

uz.context: Maktab xayriya tadbiri uchun internetdan surat topdingiz. Surat CC BY-NC litsenziyasiga ega.
uz.question: Bu litsenziya nimaga ruxsat beradi?

options.A: Suratning o‘zini sotmasangiz, undan istalgan tarzda bepul foydalanish mumkin.
options.B: Muallifni ko‘rsatish va undan tijoriy maqsadda foydalanmaslik sharti bilan ishlatish mumkin.
options.C: Creative Commons bo‘lgani uchun istalgancha foydalanish mumkin.
options.D: Suratni o‘zgartirib, o‘z ishingiz sifatida sotish mumkin.

uz.explanation: BY — muallifni ko‘rsatishni, NC esa tijoriy foydalanmaslikni talab qiladi.

en.context: An authentication API service receives a username and password from a client, hashes the password with bcrypt and compares it to the database record, then returns a signed JWT access token.
en.question: Which part represents the Process stage of the system?

options.A: The user typing their username and password into the client form.
options.B: Hashing the password with bcrypt, comparing it against the stored hash, and evaluating authentication.
options.C: Transmitting the generated JWT access token back to the HTTP client.
options.D: Physical ethernet cables transmitting raw packet voltages.

en.explanation: Credentials are Input, the JWT token is Output, and the cryptographic hash calculation and verification is Process.

uz.context: Foydalanuvchini autentifikatsiyadan o‘tkazuvchi API servisi mijozdan login va parolni qabul qiladi, parolni bcrypt algoritmi orqali xeshlab ma’lumotlar bazasidagi yozuv bilan solishtiradi va mijozga JWT tokenini qaytaradi.
uz.question: Tizimning "Process" (qayta ishlash / hisoblash) bosqichi qaysi?

options.A: Foydalanuvchining klaviaturada login va parolni kiritishi.
options.B: Parolni bcrypt orqali xeshlab, bazadagi xesh bilan solishtirish va autentifikatsiya qarorini qabul qilish.
options.C: Mijoz ilovasiga JWT tokenini JSON ko‘rinishida qaytarish.
options.D: Tarmoq kabeli orqali elektr signallarining uzatilishi.

uz.explanation: Kirish (Input) — login va parol, Chiqish (Output) — JWT token. Hisoblash va solishtirish jarayoni esa Qayta ishlash (Process) bosqichidir.
uz.context: A smart streetlight uses a light sensor to detect darkness and then sends a signal to turn on an LED bulb.
uz.question: Which part is the Process stage of the system?

options.A: The sensor measuring the light level.
options.B: The code deciding whether the light level is low enough to switch on the lamp.
options.C: The LED bulb lighting the street.
options.D: The electrical wire carrying power.

uz.explanation: In the IPO model, Process is the logical transformation or decision made using the input.

uz.context: Aqlli ko‘cha chirog‘i yorug‘lik sensori orqali qorong‘ilikni aniqlaydi va keyin LED chiroqni yoqish uchun signal yuboradi.
uz.question: Tizimning “Process” (qayta ishlash) bosqichi qaysi?

options.A: Sensorning yorug‘lik darajasini o‘lchashi.
options.B: Dastur kodining yorug‘lik yetarlicha past yoki yo‘qligini aniqlab, chiroqni yoqish haqida qaror qilishi.
options.C: LED chiroqning ko‘chani yoritishi.
options.D: Elektr simining tokni uzatishi.

uz.explanation: IPO modelida “Process” — kiruvchi ma’lumot asosida bajariladigan mantiqiy qayta ishlash yoki qaror qabul qilish bosqichi.

en.context: A pointer in a 2D grid starts at coordinate (1,1). MOVE_RIGHT increments x (x = x + 1), while MOVE_UP increments y (y = y + 1).
en.question: Which instruction sequence moves the pointer to (2,3)?
en.context: A robot starts at (1,1). MOVE_RIGHT increases the first number by 1. MOVE_UP increases the second number by 1.
en.question: Which sequence moves it to (2,3)?

options.A: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP
options.B: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP, MOVE_UP
options.C: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP
options.D: MOVE_UP, MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_RIGHT

en.explanation: Starting at (1,1), one MOVE_RIGHT gives (2,1) and two MOVE_UP commands increment y by 2 to reach (2,3).

uz.context: 2D matritsada kursor (1,1) koordinatadan boshlaydi. MOVE_RIGHT x koordinatasini 1 ga oshiradi (x = x + 1), MOVE_UP esa y koordinatasini 1 ga oshiradi (y = y + 1).
uz.question: Kursorni (2,3) koordinataga olib borish uchun qaysi buyruqlar ketma-ketligi to‘g‘ri?
uz.explanation: From (1,1), one RIGHT gives (2,1), then two UP commands give (2,3).

uz.context: Robot (1,1) nuqtadan boshlaydi. MOVE_RIGHT birinchi sonni 1 ga oshiradi. MOVE_UP ikkinchi sonni 1 ga oshiradi.
uz.question: Qaysi buyruqlar ketma-ketligi robotni (2,3) nuqtaga olib boradi?

options.A: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP
options.B: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP, MOVE_UP
options.C: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP
options.D: MOVE_UP, MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_RIGHT

uz.explanation: (1,1) dan bitta MOVE_RIGHT (2,1) ga olib keladi. Ikkita MOVE_UP esa y ni 1 dan 3 ga oshiradi: (2,3).
(1,1) dan bitta RIGHT → (2,1), undan keyin ikkita UP → (2,3).

en.question: If the input is [Circle, Triangle], what is the output?

options.A: [Square, Circle]
options.B: [Triangle, Square]
options.C: [Circle, Triangle]
options.D: [Square, Triangle]

en.explanation: Circle maps to Square, and Triangle maps to Circle. Output is [Square, Circle].

uz.context: Ma’lumotlarni qayta ishlash algoritmi har bir belgini tsiklik qoida bo‘yicha almashtiradi: Circle → Square, Square → Triangle, Triangle → Circle.
uz.question: Kiruvchi massiv [Circle, Triangle] bo‘lsa, algoritm chiqargan natija qanday bo‘ladi?

options.A: [Square, Circle]
options.B: [Triangle, Square]
options.C: [Circle, Triangle]
options.D: [Square, Triangle]

uz.explanation: Circle qoida bo‘yicha Square ga, Triangle esa Circle ga aylanadi. Natija: [Square, Circle].
Each shape is replaced by the next in the cycle Circle → Square → Triangle → Circle.

uz.question: Kirish [Doira, Uchburchak] bo‘lsa, chiqish qanday bo‘ladi?

options.B: [Uchburchak, Kvadrat]
options.C: [Doira, Uchburchak]
options.D: [Kvadrat, Uchburchak]

uz.explanation: Har bir shakl sikldagi keyingi shaklga almashadi: Doira → Kvadrat → Uchburchak → Doira.

en.context: An engineering team is architecting a full-scale e-commerce platform from scratch.
en.question: Which option demonstrates the most effective architectural decomposition of this system?

options.A: Writing all business logic into a single file and naming servers alphabetically.
options.B: Focusing solely on UI wireframes while postponing database design.
options.C: Decomposing into Authentication, Product Catalog, Cart/Payment Gateway, and Order Database services.
options.D: Hiring more developers and prioritizing advertising campaigns.

en.explanation: Decomposition isolates distinct domain responsibilities into modular, maintainable subsystems.

uz.question: Ushbu tizimni to‘g‘ri mustaqil modullarga (arxitekturaviy dekompozitsiya) ajratish qaysi variantda ko‘rsatilgan?

options.A: Barcha kodni bitta katta faylga yozib, server nomini alifbo tartibida tanlash.
options.B: Faqat frontend dizayniga e’tibor qaratib, ma’lumotlar bazasini keyinroq o‘ylash.

options.D: Dasturchilar sonini oshirish va faqat marketing reklamasini rejalashtirish.

uz.explanation: Murakkab tizimni funksional jihatdan mustaqil xizmatlarga bo‘lish — bu to‘g‘ri arxitekturaviy dekompozitsiyadir.
uz.context: You are planning a New Student Orientation Day.
uz.question: Which option breaks this large task into the clearest smaller jobs?

options.A: List every student alphabetically.
options.B: Choose only the start and end time.
options.C: Break the plan into Transport, Food/Drinks, Activity Schedule, and Budget.
options.D: Buy decorations and invite a guest speaker.

uz.explanation: Decomposition means breaking a large problem into meaningful component parts that can be solved separately.

uz.context: Siz yangi o‘quvchilar uchun tanishtiruv kunini rejalashtiryapsiz.
uz.question: Qaysi variant bu katta vazifani eng tushunarli kichik ishlarga ajratadi?

options.A: Barcha o‘quvchilarni alifbo tartibida yozish.
options.B: Faqat boshlanish va tugash vaqtini belgilash.
options.C: Rejani Transport, Oziq-ovqat/ichimlik, Faoliyatlar jadvali va Budjet qismlariga ajratish.
options.D: Bezaklar sotib olish va mehmon taklif qilish.

uz.explanation: Decomposition — katta muammoni alohida hal qilish mumkin bo‘lgan mazmunli qismlarga ajratishdir.

en.context: A software engineer is designing a high-level Database Client API for backend developers.
en.question: To maintain effective abstraction, which low-level detail should be hidden from API consumers?

options.A: The high-level query() execution method.
options.B: The connection establishment connect() method.
options.C: Network interface bus voltages and low-level hardware interrupt register offsets.
options.D: The schema format of returned dataset rows.

en.explanation: Abstraction hides physical hardware complexities behind high-level declarative interfaces.

uz.question: Interfeysni tushunarli va abstrakt saqlash uchun qaysi past darajali (low-level) apparat detali dasturchidan yashirilishi (abstraksiya qilinishi) kerak?

options.A: SQL so‘rovlarini bajaruvchi query() metodi.
options.B: Ma’lumotlar bazasiga ulanish uchun connect() funksiyasi.
options.C: Tarmoq platasidagi elektr kuchlanishi va xotira kontrollerining apparat uzilishlari (interrupts).
options.D: Qaytariladigan ma’lumotlar jadvali va qatorlar formati.

uz.explanation: Abstraksiya past darajadagi apparat tafsilotlarini yashirib, qulay dasturiy interfeys (API) taqdim etadi.
uz.context: You are building a simple metro map for tourists to travel between stations.
uz.question: Which detail is irrelevant and should be removed to keep the map clear?

options.A: Station names.
options.B: Lines connecting stations.
